info.title: member
info.description: The member command: sync your own LinkedIn Member Data Portability data into a local SQLite database and query it.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription:
Sync your own LinkedIn Member Data Portability (DMA) data into a local SQLite database and query it.
Unofficial; not affiliated with or endorsed by LinkedIn. Reads only; never changes your LinkedIn account.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

options.name: --database
options.description: SQLite database path (default: member.db in the platform's application data directory)

options.name: --format
options.description: Output format: json (default when stdout is redirected) or table

options.name: --credential-source
options.description: keychain (default) or environment (MEMBERDATA_ACCESS_TOKEN, explicit opt-in at your own risk). Also settable with MEMBERDATA_CREDENTIAL_SOURCE

commands.name: auth
commands.description: Access token management.

commands.name: status
commands.description: Show the credential source and safe token metadata (offline). Never prints the token.

commands.name: import-token
commands.description:
Store an access token from LinkedIn's OAuth Token Generator in the operating system's secure store.
The token is read from a hidden prompt or stdin, never from arguments, and is checked against LinkedIn.
Examples:
  member auth import-token
  pbpaste | member auth import-token --stdin --expires-in-days 60

options.name: --stdin
options.description: Read the token from standard input instead of a hidden prompt [default: False]

options.name: --expires-at
options.description: Token expiry as shown by LinkedIn's token generator (ISO 8601)

options.name: --expires-in-days
options.description: Token lifetime in days from now, as shown by LinkedIn's token generator

options.name: --no-verify
options.description: Store without checking the token against LinkedIn [default: False]

commands.name: logout
commands.description: Remove the stored token from the secure store. The database is kept.

commands.name: registration
commands.description:
Check with LinkedIn whether the member is registered for DMA data generation (online, read-only).
Use when no data appears a few minutes after generating the token.

commands.name: register
commands.description:
Ask LinkedIn to start DMA data generation for the member (online). LinkedIn normally does this
automatically when the token is generated; use only when 'member auth registration' reports none.

commands.name: domains
commands.description: Snapshot domains.

commands.name: list
commands.description: Documented and discovered snapshot domains with their local status (offline).

commands.name: sync
commands.description:
Fetch the changelog and, when needed, the snapshot from LinkedIn into the database (online).
Without options the strategy is chosen safely: an initial full snapshot, a daily snapshot refresh, a
recovery snapshot after a changelog gap, otherwise only the changelog.
Examples:
  member sync
  member sync --full
  member sync --domain CONNECTIONS

options.name: --full
options.description: Refresh every snapshot domain, then catch up the changelog [default: False]

options.name: --domain
options.description: Refresh only this snapshot domain (case sensitive)

commands.name: status
commands.description: Checkpoints, recent runs, changelog age and retention warnings (offline).

commands.name: data
commands.description: Read the local database.

commands.name: list
commands.description:
List stored snapshot records (offline), ordered by domain, first seen and key.
Example: member data list --domain CONNECTIONS --limit 50 --offset 50

options.name: --domain
options.description: Snapshot domain, e.g. CONNECTIONS

options.name: --limit
options.description: Maximum records (1-1000) [default: 50]

options.name: --offset
options.description: Records to skip [default: 0]

options.name: --include-deleted
options.description: Include records no longer in LinkedIn's snapshot [default: False]

commands.name: get
commands.description: Show one stored snapshot record (offline).

options.name: --domain
options.description: Snapshot domain

options.name: --id
options.description: Record key from 'member data list'

commands.name: query
commands.description:
Run one read-only SQL SELECT against the local database (offline). Tables: snapshot_records,
changelog_events, snapshot_domains, sync_runs, sync_checkpoints, database_info. Use SQLite JSON
functions on the json column. The database holds personal data about you and other people:
never expose this command to untrusted clients.
Examples:
  member data query "SELECT domain, count(*) AS n FROM snapshot_records GROUP BY domain"
  member data query "SELECT json_extract(json, '$.Company') AS company, count(*) AS n FROM snapshot_records WHERE domain = 'CONNECTIONS' AND deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY n DESC"
  member data query --file ./queries/overview.sql

options.name: --file
options.description: Read the SELECT statement from this file

options.name: --max-rows
options.description: Stop after this many rows (result marked truncated) [default: 1000]

options.name: --timeout
options.description: Seconds before the query is interrupted [default: 30]

commands.name: database
commands.description: The local database.

commands.name: info
commands.description: Path, schema version, member binding and record counts (offline).

commands.name: purge
commands.description: Delete the local database and its WAL files. Requires --yes. LinkedIn data and the token are untouched.

options.name: --yes
options.description: Confirm deleting the local database [default: False]

commands.name: skill
commands.description: The agent skill for Claude Code, Codex and other coding agents.

commands.name: install
commands.description:
Install the agent skill that teaches coding agents to use member (offline first, JSON, ask before
syncing). Writes member/SKILL.md into each target's user-level skills directory; running it again
updates the skill to this version.
Examples:
  member skill install
  member skill install --target claude
  member skill install --dir ./.agents/skills

options.name: --target
options.description: claude (~/.claude/skills: Claude Code), agents (~/.agents/skills: Codex, Gemini CLI, GitHub Copilot, OpenCode) or all [default: all]

options.name: --dir
options.description: Install into this skills directory instead (a member/ folder is created in it)

options.name: --force
options.description: Overwrite a member/SKILL.md that was not written by member [default: False]

commands.name: show
commands.description: Print the agent skill (SKILL.md) for agents with other skill locations.
